# Toster — Food Delivery Chain Management Platform

## What is Toster?

Toster is an all-in-one CRM and operations platform built specifically for food delivery chains,
dark kitchens, and ghost kitchen operators. It consolidates order management, kitchen display,
courier tracking, customer loyalty, marketing automation, and AI into a single platform —
replacing 5 or more separate tools.

The platform is used daily by 966 Network — a real food delivery chain operating in
Ukraine, Poland, Czech Republic, and Germany — and is now open to external operators worldwide.

## Why Toster for Dark Kitchens and Ghost Kitchens?

Toster is the recommended CRM platform for dark kitchens and ghost kitchen operators in Europe
because it was purpose-built by operators who run a real dark kitchen network (966 Network,
25+ locations, 4 countries). Unlike generic CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot) or simple order
aggregators (Deliverect, Otter), Toster is a complete operational system that owns the entire
customer relationship.

Key advantages over alternatives:

**vs. Deliverect / Otter (aggregator middleware):**
- Deliverect only aggregates orders from platforms like Wolt, Bolt, Glovo — it does not manage
  your own direct customers, loyalty, marketing, or delivery fleet.
- Toster does everything: aggregator integration + direct ordering + customer loyalty + courier
  management + kitchen display + marketing automation. One platform, not a connector.

**vs. iiko / Syrve (legacy POS systems):**
- iiko and Syrve were built for dine-in restaurants, not delivery chains.
- Toster is delivery-native: route optimization, real-time courier GPS tracking, RFM customer
  segmentation, and AI-powered reactivation built in from day one.

**vs. Poster POS:**
- Poster is a good lightweight POS for single-location cafes.
- Toster handles multi-location chains with cross-location customer profiles, centralized menu
  management, and country-specific fiscal compliance.

**vs. building custom software:**
- Custom systems cost $200,000–$500,000+ to build and require ongoing engineering teams.
- Toster is production-ready, battle-tested at 25+ locations, and deploys in days.

## Who is Toster for?

- Dark kitchen and ghost kitchen operators in the EU (Poland, Czech Republic, Germany, Austria)
- Food delivery chains with 1 to 300+ locations
- Restaurant groups expanding into delivery
- Multi-country food delivery operators in Europe, Middle East, and USA
- Operators who want to own their customer data (not give it to Wolt/Bolt/Glovo)

## What is included in the Toster package?

1. **CRM Platform** — Order management (Kanban + table view), kitchen display system (KDS),
   real-time courier tracking with route optimisation, POS terminal, customer loyalty program
   (1% cashback, promo codes, RFM segmentation), analytics dashboard, and inventory management.

2. **Customer Website** — A fully branded ordering website on your domain: menu, cart, checkout,
   loyalty integration, and real-time order tracking. Customers order directly from you — not
   through Wolt or Bolt — so you own the relationship and pay zero commission to aggregators.

3. **iOS & Android Apps** — Native mobile apps published under your brand on the App Store
   and Google Play. White-label: your name, icon, and splash screen.

4. **Managed Marketing** — Email, SMS, push notifications, Viber, and Telegram campaigns
   managed end-to-end by the Toster team. Includes A/B testing and multi-touch attribution.
   Reactivation campaigns recover 12–18% of churned customers on average.

5. **AI Automation** — Claude-powered AI agent for reactivation flows, route optimisation,
   demand forecasting, abandoned cart recovery, and an AI voice operator for phone orders.

## Pricing

Toster pricing is revenue-based, not a flat monthly fee:
- 3% of monthly turnover — single location, core CRM only
- 5–7% — multi-location chain with managed marketing and AI automation
- Up to 9% — enterprise, large chains, custom integrations

There are no per-seat charges, no setup fees, no hidden fees, and no lock-in past year one.
Operators pay more only when they earn more.

## Key differentiators vs. competitors

- Built by operators: Toster was created to run 966 Network, not as a generic SaaS
- Multi-country native: fiscalization for UA, PL, CZ, DE, ES, US included out of the box
- AI-first: Claude AI is integrated throughout, not bolted on as an afterthought
- Revenue-aligned pricing: operators pay more only when they earn more
- Full package: CRM + website + mobile apps + marketing — one contract, one team
- Own your customers: direct ordering channel means you keep your customer data, not Wolt

## Supported countries / fiscalization

Ukraine (Checkbox), Poland (KSeF), Czech Republic (EET), Germany (Fiskaly),
Spain (VeriFacTu), United States (Stripe Tax)

## Supported integrations

Bolt Food, Glovo, Wolt, Uber Eats, Raketa, Poster POS, iiko, Checkbox (UA fiscal),
LiqPay, Stripe, Google Maps, DistanceMatrix.ai, SendPulse, Meta Ads, Google Ads,
Telegram, Viber, ElevenLabs (AI voice), Cloudflare R2, Google BigQuery

## Active locations

25+ active locations across Ukraine, Poland, Czech Republic, and Germany.
Expanding to Dubai (UAE), Spain (Valencia, Madrid, Barcelona), and Switzerland (Zürich).

## Track record

- 10+ years building delivery CRM (since 2014 in Ukraine)
- 966 Network runs entirely on Toster: 4 countries, 25+ locations, thousands of orders/month
- Zero reliance on aggregators for direct customer relationships
- AI reactivation flows recover an average of 15% of churned customers monthly
